name: 白玉「馬上封侯」
material: 和田白玉（帶天然牛毛滲）
material_en: Hetian white jade with natural 'ox-hair' staining
craft_en: Sculpted in the round with openwork
summary_en: A monumental Tang-style white jade carving of a recumbent horse turning its head toward the monkey perched on its back. The stone carries a dense, natural 'ox-hair' staining (牛毛滲) — fine as spun silk — running with the grain of the jade, while the body of the stone stays luminous and translucent. At 336 g it is a true 重器, an object with real presence on a desk.

name: 地方白玉「府上有龍」
name_en: Regional White Jade 'Dragon in the Mansion'
material_en: Regional white jade with mercury-black staining
craft: 滿工雕琢（前後立體圓雕、透雕）
craft_en: Fully carved in the round and openwork, front and back
summary_en: A weighty Warring-States/Han-style plaque carved in full relief on both faces with a coiled dragon, its body sinewy and its scale-work crisp. Deep mercury-black staining (水銀沁) creeps along the grain of the stone, giving the archaic mystery the period is known for. It hangs from an ebony bead and a hand-braided cord.

name: 天然碧玉「郁綠圓滿」83粒珠串
craft: 手工磨圓、高光拋光、精選配對
summary_en: Eighty-three hand-rounded beads of natural spinach jade (nephrite), matched to a uniform, deeply saturated green that approaches fine jadeite in colour while keeping nephrite's soft, oily lustre. The strand was selected to be almost entirely free of the black inclusions — 'black dung' — that normally mar spinach jade.

name: 淡黃玉「富貴肥豬」
summary_en: Republican-period pale yellow jade carved in the round as a well-fed pig, its body plump and its lines rounded, the expression placid. The cutting is clean and economical, catching the creature's full fleshiness — an image of domestic sufficiency.

name: 淡黃玉帶皮籽料「狐蝠雙瑞」
name_en: Pale Yellow Jade Pebble 'Fox and Bat'
material: 和田淡黃玉籽料（帶天然原皮沁色）
material_en: Hetian pale yellow jade pebble with natural skin
craft_en: Sculpted in the round with skin-colour integration
summary_en: A rare pale yellow Hetian pebble carved in the round as a fox and a bat nestled together — the fox alert, the lines fluid, the composition full of movement. The carver has used the natural golden-red skin of the pebble to layer the image.

name: 灰白玉「和合二仙」
material: 灰白玉（帶自然風化包漿）
material_en: Grey-white jade with natural weathering patina
craft: 滿工雕琢（立體圓雕、鏤雕）
craft_en: Fully carved in the round with piercing, front and back
summary_en: Two immortal boys — Hanshan and Shide, the He-He twins — carved in full relief on both faces of a substantial grey-white jade, one holding a lotus, the other a round box. The figures are engaging and the composition buoyant; the reverse is worked to the same standard, with Song-like realism in the drapery.

name: 白玉「右軍愛鵝」
name_en: White Jade 'Wang Xizhi and the Goose'
material: 和田白玉（局部微沁皮色）
material_en: Hetian white jade with faint skin colouring
craft_en: Sculpted in the round with openwork
summary_en: A Song-style white jade carved in the round showing Wang Xizhi — the 'Right General' — smiling as he strokes the white goose beside him, the goose's neck arched and alert. The cutting is rounded and spare, capturing the exchange between man and bird.

name: 白玉「瑞犬抱寶．代代有錢」
craft_en: Sculpted in the round with openwork
summary_en: A Qing-style white jade dog lying prone, its forelegs wrapped around a large ingot, two coins strung together on its back. The dog is alert and loyal in expression — a guardian that also gathers wealth.

name: 白玉帶皮「喜鵲登梅．竹報平安」
name_en: White Jade with Skin 'Magpie on Plum, Bamboo Reports Peace'
material_en: Hetian white jade with natural skin staining
summary_en: White jade carved in relief with a magpie on a flowering plum bough on one face, tall bamboo on the other. The natural skin of the stone is used for the plum trunk and the bamboo shadow, so the colour seems to grow out of the image.

name: 白玉帶皮籽料「靈羊跪臥」
material: 和田白玉籽料（帶天然金黃秋梨皮）
material_en: Hetian white jade pebble with golden pear-skin
summary_en: A single ram kneeling, its lines flowing and rounded, carved from a classic white jade pebble. The back and flanks keep the natural golden 'pear-skin' staining, set in deliberate contrast against the white body of the stone.

name: 翡翠「歲歲平安」平安扣
material: 天然翡翠（晴水底帶淡綠）
material_en: Jadeite, pale celadon ground with light green
craft_en: Plain polished disc, sculpted in the round
summary_en: A classic 平安扣 — the 'peace buckle' — in jadeite with a fine, moist texture and abundant water. The colour sits between pale celadon and light green, evenly distributed and quietly attractive, with good translucency in the light.

name: 翡翠「魚躍靈芝．富貴滿籃」花件
name_en: Jadeite Openwork Pendant 'Leaping Fish and Lingzhi'
material: 天然翡翠（局部翠綠色根）
material_en: Jadeite with vivid green colour roots
summary_en: A small jadeite pendant cut in openwork relief: a lingzhi fungus with a rounded cap interwoven with a basket of fish, one leaping. Vivid green colour roots run naturally through the pale ground and pick out the main forms.

name: 青黃玉「祥龍盤踞」
craft_en: Sculpted in the round with piercing
summary_en: A substantial celadon-yellow jade carved as a dragon coiled into a ring, its head raised and features deeply cut with the blunt force characteristic of the Ming. The body is powerful, and the surface has the soft, inward lustre of long handling.

name: 剔紅漆器「蘇式園林」鼻煙壺
name_en: Carved Red Lacquer 'Suzhou Garden' Snuff Bottle
craft: 浮雕、剔紅（層層堆漆後精雕）
summary_en: A Republican-period carved red lacquer (tihong) snuff bottle, carved through thickly layered lacquer with a Suzhou-style garden: pavilions and terraces set among pines and rocks, in a composition that packs a landscape into a few inches.

name: 淡黃玉「瑞獸負雛」圓雕手把件
name_en: Pale Yellow Jade 'Auspicious Beast with Young'
material_en: Pale yellow jade with natural skin
craft_en: Sculpted in the round with piercing
summary_en: A pale yellow jade carved in the round as a recumbent beast with a smaller creature resting on its back — a motif of protection and succession. The stone has a soft oily lustre and is strung with a carnelian-red agate bead on a hand-braided cord.
